shortDescription: Manage protocol properties on Solaris/illumos systems.

options.name: property
options.description: Specifies the name of property we want to manage.

options.name: protocol
options.description: Specifies the protocol for which we want to manage properties.

options.name: state
options.description: Set or reset the property value.

options.name: temporary
options.description: Specifies that the property value is temporary. Temporary property values do not persist across reboots.

options.name: value
options.description: Specifies the value we want to set for the property.
